verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an official MCP server at https://app.puzzle.io/mcp, with a setup guide for connecting Claude and other assistants, a broad set of ledger tools, and beta write access that confirms each change with the user. Other Puzzle help articles also point users to querying runway and AR aging through the Puzzle MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection, and write access is still labeled Beta.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation
Once connected, open a new conversation and start exploring your financials.
ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant through the Puzzle MCP
